latest_release.name: Ventoy 1.1.18 release
latest_release.body:
**Changelog** 1. Experimental support for SteamOS recovery images. (#3712 #2875 #1815) 2. Improve the Linux remount feature to make the ISO partition mountable out of the box on mainstream desktop distros. ([Notes](https://www.ventoy.net/en/doc_linux_remount.html)) 3. Suppress the duplicate disk icons in the sidebar on some Linux desktop distros. 4. Change the ISO partition dm name to stable /dev/mapper/VentoyPart, please refer [Notes](https://www.ventoy.net/en/doc_linux_remount.html) 5. Make the ISO partition mountable for CloneZilla. (#3274) 6. Fix Fedora 45 beta boot issue. 7. Fix the Windows/WinPE secure boot version check failed issue. 8. Fix Persistence intermittently fails on Ubuntu desktop. (#3718) 9. Fix the boot issue for Grml 2026.09. (#3751) 10. Add support for custom Syslinux-based ISO. (#3760) 11. Improvement for latest LinuxConsole release. (#3745) 12. Add check for Boot Conf Replace entries in VentoyPlugson. (#3727 #3593) **SHA256** ``` d86ff9de63d94c8b8f1f6b14d23c55af4b88e8207bf2893890892a6a97b1ad54 ventoy-1.1.18-linux.tar.gz ee3917bd5a9973c0b2f8f3ef85048bf68ae089ec88f5561ad78b6ad308b51ab5 ventoy-1.1.18-livecd.iso 082c478e8c432e1ac653899fcf50e3a4077a2851bc6112b5ddd30545962164a9 ventoy-1.1.18-windows.zip ```

Extremely easy to use, Many advanced features. x86 Legacy BIOS, IA32 UEFI, x86_64 UEFI (Secure Boot), ARM64 UEFI and LoongArch64 UEFI mode supported 110+ common types of OS supported (Windows/WinPE/Linux/Unix/VMware) Turn any PC, laptop, server, NAS, or Raspberry Pi into a PXE/HTTPBoot server instantly! ......
